- Build a complete, playable mobile idle-action game about cookie characters fighting to protect a chef from being eaten.
- Match the requested cute, cinematic, pixel/voxel-inspired visual style with soft shadows.

- Visual direction: pixel voxel art, soft shadow, cute, cinematic.

- Added idle combat, manual tap attacks, upgrades, a special honey attack, saved progress, offline crumbs, and a repeatable escape-plan reward.
